items.title: Three basic properties of a Noetherian topological space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects three properties of a Noetherian topological space: every subspace is Noetherian, there are finitely many irreducible components, and each component contains a nonempty open subset (author lemma at source lines 1469-1477, label lemma-Noetherian). The proof (source lines 1479-1518) transfers the descending chain condition to subspaces, runs a minimal-counterexample argument for finiteness of the components using the reducibility of a minimal bad closed subset and closes it with the irredundant-union statement, and reads off the third assertion from the generic points (proof lines 1479-1517). The minimal-counterexample argument is the substance. H3.
